nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a partition of $n$ with $\ell$ parts $x_1 \ge x_2 \ge \cdots \ge x_\ell$. The number of lit cells of $p$, drawn as a weakly decreasing bargraph, is defined as $\max_{1 \le i \le \ell} (x_i + i - 1)$, and as $0$ when $p$ has no parts. It is the largest part of the image of $p$ under Prodinger's bijection $x_i \mapsto x_i + i - 1$.

nodes.summary: For a natural number $r$, the triangle partition series is the power series $T_q(r) = \sum_{s=0}^{r} t[r, s] \in \mathbb{Z}[[q]]$, where $t[r, s]$ is the triangular $q$-binomial coefficient. It is the generating function of partitions contained in the triangle with column heights $r, r - 1, \dots, 1$.
nodes.title: Triangle partition series

nodes.summary: The triangular $q$-binomial coefficients $t[r, s] \in \mathbb{Z}[[q]]$ satisfy the recursion $t[r, s] = q^s \sum_{i=0}^{s} t[r - 1, i]$ for all natural numbers $r \ge 1$ and $s \le r$, together with the initial conditions $t[1, 1] = q$, $t[2, 1] = q(1 + q)$, $t[r, 0] = 1$ for every $r$, and $t[r, s] = 0$ whenever $r < s$.

nodes.summary: For every natural number $r$, the triangular $q$-binomial coefficient satisfies $t[r, 0] = 1$: only the empty partition has no parts.

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $r$ and $s$, the triangular $q$-binomial coefficient $t[r, s] \in \mathbb{Z}[[q]]$ is the power series whose coefficient of $q^n$ is the number of partitions of $n$ with exactly $s$ parts $x_1 \ge \dots \ge x_s$ that fit in the staircase with column heights $r, r - 1, \dots, r - s + 1$, that is, with $x_i + (i - 1) \le r$ for $1 \le i \le s$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
